records.issue_text: Salesforce bypasses `refreshOAuthTokens` and always refreshes directly with Salesforce, preventing externally synced Salesforce credentials from being refreshed through `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`.
records.rationale: Verified in the diff: the new Salesforce code (`fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)`) refreshes directly and does not use `refreshOAuthTokens`, unlike every other app (google, office365, zoom, webex, zoho, lark, hubspot) which were wrapped in it. The mechanism described is accurate. records.issue_text: The OAuth token sync request includes no authentication header or secret, requiring an endpoint serving tokens by user ID and app slug to be exposed without caller authentication.
records.rationale: Verifiable in the diff: refreshOAuthTokens in packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts fetches process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT with only method and body (calcomUserId, appSlug) and no Authorization header or secret, unlike the inbound webhook (app-credential.ts) which verifies CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Any caller who can reach the endpoint can obtain OAuth tokens for arbitrary user/app pairs.
